# Template: causal_dag
A causal directed acyclic graph (DAG): an exposure node far left, an outcome node far right, and any confounders (banded above the exposure- outcome line), mediators (sitting on that line, between exposure and outcome), and colliders (banded below), connected by straight causal arrows. Optionally tints the confounder's edges to highlight the backdoor path it opens. Choose this scene for ANY request about a causal diagram, causal DAG, confounder, confounding, collider, collider bias, mediator, mediation, backdoor path, or the causal structure behind an exposure- outcome relationship.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "nodes": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
     "name": {
      "type": "string"
     },
     "role": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
       "exposure",
       "outcome",
       "confounder",
       "collider",
       "mediator"
      ],
      "description": "Determines placement; unspecified/other roles are placed as mediators."
     }
    },
    "required": [
     "name"
    ]
   }
  },
  "edges": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "kit.parseEdgeList notation, e.g. \"Coffee -> Heart disease; Stress -> Coffee; Stress -> Heart disease\". Only -> is meaningful for a causal DAG."
  },
  "highlight_backdoor": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Tint edges touching a confounder to flag the backdoor path it opens (default false)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- node_<slug>: a node (ellipse halo + its name), one per entry in `nodes`
- edge_<i>: the i-th parsed edge's arrow
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Show how a confounder biases the effect of coffee on heart disease." → params: {"nodes":[{"name":"Coffee","role":"exposure"},{"name":"Heart disease","role":"outcome"},{"name":"Stress","role":"confounder"}],"edges":"Coffee -> Heart disease; Stress -> Coffee; Stress -> Heart disease","highlight_backdoor":true,"title":"Confounding by stress"}
Request: "Draw a causal DAG with a mediator between exposure and outcome." → params: {"nodes":[{"name":"Exercise","role":"exposure"},{"name":"Mortality","role":"outcome"},{"name":"Fitness","role":"mediator"}],"edges":"Exercise -> Fitness; Fitness -> Mortality; Exercise -> Mortality"}

In YAML: `template: causal_dag` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
